I, {owner}, as the responsible owner/guardian of {pet}, authorize the veterinary team to perform {procedure} and the anesthesia and/or sedation required, on {date}.

I confirm that the diagnosis, the proposed procedure, its alternatives, expected benefits and risks, including anesthetic risks (which, although uncommon, may include serious complications or death), have been explained to me in clear language and that I have been able to ask all the questions I considered necessary.

I have disclosed my pet's known health status, medication and history, and I have complied with the fasting instructions. I authorize any additional procedures that become essential due to an unforeseen situation during surgery, in the patient's best interest; the team will inform me as soon as possible. I agree to pay the fees and costs according to the estimate provided and to follow the post-operative instructions.

Owner signature: ____________ ID: ________
Veterinarian: ____________ License no.: ________

I, {owner}, as the responsible owner/guardian of {pet}, freely and voluntarily request and authorize the euthanasia of my pet on {date}.

I confirm that the veterinarian has explained the clinical condition and prognosis, the available alternatives and the procedure ({procedure}), which will be carried out humanely, with prior sedation, to avoid pain and distress. I declare that the animal has not bitten any person or animal in the last 10 days.

Regarding the body, I choose: [ ] take it home [ ] individual cremation [ ] communal cremation [ ] other: ________.

Owner signature: ____________ ID: ________
Veterinarian: ____________ License no.: ________

I, {owner}, as the responsible owner/guardian of {pet}, authorize the hospitalization of my pet from {date} for {procedure}.

I confirm that I have been informed of the reason for hospitalization, the diagnostic and treatment plan, the risks, the prognosis and the estimated daily cost, which may vary depending on progress. I authorize the treatments, tests and emergency procedures the team considers necessary, and in case of cardiopulmonary arrest: [ ] I authorize resuscitation (CPR) [ ] I do not authorize resuscitation (DNR).

I agree to keep my contact details up to date, to collect my pet upon discharge and to pay the hospitalization costs.
